Elite: Group A: At Vadodara: Bihar 166 & 251 in 76.2 overs (Mangal Mahrour 138, Ayush Loharuka 49, Bhargav Bhatt 6/53) lost to Baroda 416 in 114.1 overs (Priyanshu Moliya 132, Mahesh Pithiya 61, Deepak Hooda 70, Raj Limbani 44, Amod Yadav 5/139) & 4/0 in 1.1 overs; Points: Baroda 7, Bihar 0.
At Puducherry: Pondicherry 177 & 98/1 in 38 overs (Ritesh Gudge 47 batting) vs. Madhya Pradesh 345 in 111.2 overs (Chanchal Rathore 78, Shubham Sharma 58, Rajat Patidar 122, Atharva Mahajan 43, Sagar Trivedi 4/44).
At Srinagar: Jammu & Kashmir 260 & 123 in 39.2 overs (Nachiket Bhute 5/48) lost to Vidarbha 305 in 73 overs (R. Samarth 143, Rajneesh Gurbani 64 n.o., Umar Nazir Mir 4/56, Sunil Kumar 4/73) & 81/7 in 22.5 overs (Sunil Kumar 4/30); Vidarbha 6, J&K 0.
At Kanpur: Uttar Pradesh 202 & 197 in 58.4 overs (Aryan Juyal 74, Yash Kasvankar 5/69) bt Goa 164 in 61.3 overs (Shivendra Bhujbal 44, Zeeshan Ansari 5/45) & 167 in 46 overs (Suyash Prabhudessai 72, Kartik Yadav 5/37); UP 6, Goa 0.
Group B: At Guwahati: Assam 334 in 111.1 overs (Sibsankar Roy 54, Sumit Ghadigaonkar 49, Swarupam Purkayastha 69, Sandip Sarkar 4/76) & 36/1 in 13.2 overs bt Tripura 62 in 22.1 overs & 307 in 67.4 overs (Sentu Sarkar 59, Manisankar Murasingh 161, Mohit Thakur 5/101); Assam 6, Tripura 0.
At Mulapadu: Hyderabad 275 & 306/7 decl. in 95.3 overs (Tanmay Agarwal 49, Kodimela Himateja 123 n.o., Tanay Thyagarajan 53 n.o., Kavuri Saiteja 4/40) vs. Andhra 184 in 63 overs (Shaik Rasheed 61, Tanay Thyagarajan 5/63) & 7/2 in 4 overs.
At Alur: Karnataka 342 in 111.3 overs (Mayank Agarwal 42, K.V. Aneesh 59, Karun Nair 46, Manvanth Kumar 135, Parth Bhut 5/89) & 99/2 in 26 overs vs. Saurashtra 349 in 108.3 overs (Hetvik Kotak 46, Harvik Desai 77, Arpit Vasavada 65, Sammar Gajjar 79, Vidwath Kaverappa 4/57).
At New Chandigarh: Punjab 456 in 152.5 overs (Vihaan Malhotra 40, Uday Saharan 161, Prabhsimran Singh 62, Salil Arora 107, Dharmendrasinh Jadeja 7/173) vs. Chhattisgarh 206 in 64.5 overs (Amandeep Khare 91, Vikalp Tiwari 47, Harpreet Brar 7/56) & 123/3 in 54 overs (Aayush Pandey 59 batting).
Group C: At Pune: Jharkhand 169 & 130/1 in 47 overs (Shikhar Mohan 74 batting, Utkarsh Singh 45 batting) vs. Maharashtra 527/5 decl. in 150 overs (Sachin Dhas 58, Digvijay Patil 148, Ankit Bawne 169 n.o., Ruturaj Gaikwad 101 n.o.).
At Delhi: Delhi 648/6 decl. in 136.4 overs (Priyansh Arya 199, Ayush Badoni 217, Sumit Mathur 92, Anuj Rawat 61 batting) vs. Gujarat 363/5 in 120 overs (Manan Hingrajia 108 batting, Jaymeet Patel 72, Chintan Gaja 41 batting).
At Delhi: Bengal 184 & 146 in 52.5 overs (Rahul Singh 5/43) bt Services 122 in 62.2 overs (Rajat Paliwal 48 n.o., Shahbaz Ahmed 4/35, Aamir Gani 4/31) & 148 in 68.5 overs (Nitin Tanwar 49, Pradipta Pramanik 4/48); Bengal 6, Services 0.
At Thiruvananthapuram: Kerala 404 in 129.3 overs (Sachin Baby 112, Mohammed Azharuddeen 139 n.o., Aditya Sarwate 53) vs. Odisha 225 in 84.1 overs (Gourav Choudhary 50, Subhranshu Senapati 50, Vaisakh Chandran 4/40) & 102/4 in 35 overs (Gourav Choudhary 53).
Group D: At Rohtak: Chandigarh 103 & 118 in 47 overs (Manan Vohra 47, Nishant Sindhu 6/27) lost to Haryana 245 in 77.1 overs (Nishant Sindhu 92, Yashvardhan Dalal 95, Nishunk Birla 5/63); Haryana 7, Chandigarh 0.
At Bilaspur: Himachal Pradesh 140 & 144/3 in 56 overs vs. Mumbai 528/8 decl. in 151 overs (Musheer Khan 57, Siddhesh Lad 87, Sarfaraz Khan 154, Akash Anand 117 n.o., Jitender Rana 4/108).
At Chennai: Uttarakhand 134 & 113 in 45.4 overs (Sai Kishore 6/34, Ajith Ram 4/33) lost to Tamil Nadu 313 in 109 overs (Pradosh Ranjan Paul 136, B. Indrajith 77, Mayank Mishra 5/118, Avneesh Sudha 4/34); TN 7, Uttarakhand 0.
At Jaipur: Rajasthan 497 in 136 overs (Sachin Yadav 194, Karan Lamba 194) vs. Railways 305/6 in 112 overs (Eshaan Goyal 64, Bhargav Merai 73, Ravi Singh 53).
Plate: At Nadiad: Arunachal Pradesh 121 & 123 in 54 overs (Satyajeet Bachhav 5/27) lost to Sikkim 572/5 decl. in 142 overs (Nilesh Lamichaney 134, Ashish Thapa 70, Parth Palawat 151, Gurinder Singh 146); Sikkim 7, Arunachal 0.
At Shillong: Meghalaya 380 in 101 overs (Kevin Christopher 110, Arpit Bhatewara 54, Swastic Chettri 84, Pheiroijam Jotin 5/79) & 172 in 51.5 overs (Pheiroijam Jotin 4/21) vs. Manipur 277 in 92 overs (Karnajit Yumnam 100, Rex Rajkumar 43, Abhishek Kumar 4/60) & 11/0 in three overs.
At Sovima: Mizoram 581/9 decl. in 154.1 overs (Chinmay Sutar 400 n.o., Jehu Anderson 69) vs. Nagaland 324/3 in 101 overs (Joshua Ozukum 48, Sedezhalie Rupero 108 batting, Yugandhar Singh 98).
